name: ShopSmart Loyalty for WooCommerce
author: techmixers

sections.description:
ShopSmart Loyalty for WooCommerce seamlessly integrates the ShopSmart loyalty program into your WooCommerce store. It allows you to reward your customers with loyalty points based on their purchases, which they can redeem for discounts on future orders.

Key Features:
– Loyalty Points: Award points for customer purchases.
– Tier-Based Rewards: Customers move through tiers based on their spending.
– Redemption: Customers can redeem their points for discounts on future purchases.
– OTP Verification: Secure point redemption through OTP verification.
– Real-Time Discount Application: Automatically apply loyalty discounts at checkout.

This plugin helps foster customer loyalty, increase repeat business, and enhance customer engagement by offering tangible rewards that customers can use on future purchases.

External / Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to a custom ShopSmart Loyalty API (provided by Techmixers (Pvt.) Ltd.) to enable loyalty features in WooCommerce, such as customer signup, points tracking, reward redemption, and history display.

What data is sent and when:
– Personal/customer info: Phone number, first/last name, gender, address, date of birth, email — sent during loyalty signup, phone verification, or reward redemption.
– Order/transaction info: Purchase amount, items, store details — sent when earning/redeeming points at checkout.
– Data is only sent when the user actively uses loyalty features (e.g., submits signup form, applies rewards, views history). No automatic or background sending occurs.

Service Provider:
– Provided by: Techmixers (Pvt.) Ltd. (developers of ShopSmart loyalty platform)
– Company Website: https://techmixers.com/

Privacy & Terms:
– Data handling and processing follow the privacy practices and terms set by Techmixers (Pvt.) Ltd.
– For full details on data collection, usage, storage, and protection, please refer to Techmixers / ShopSmart privacy policy and terms of service.

All communication uses secure HTTPS. This plugin does not store sensitive loyalty or personal data permanently on your WordPress site (beyond temporary WooCommerce session data); all persistent data is managed on the external API servers configured by the user.

Acknowledgements

Thanks to the WooCommerce team for their fantastic plugin and resources.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shopsmart-loyalty directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How do I configure this plugin?

Go to the ‘ShopSmart’ settings page in the WooCommerce settings panel to configure the loyalty program.

Does this plugin support multi-site?

Yes, this plugin works with WordPress multi-site.
